E-001.statement: The system shall allow authorized network administrators to create, review, update, and revoke firewall rules.

tests.given: An authorized administrator with valid credentials
tests.when: The administrator initiates a rule creation request for academic network segmentation
tests.then: The system returns a new rule configuration form with validation feedback
tests.observable_evidence: Test capture of the rule creation response and form state

tests.given: An authorized administrator with valid credentials
tests.when: The administrator submits an update to an existing firewall rule for research network access
tests.then: The system validates the change, applies it, and confirms successful update in real-time
tests.observable_evidence: Test capture of the updated rule configuration and applied state

tests.given: An authorized administrator with valid credentials
tests.when: The administrator revokes a firewall rule for hostel network access
tests.then: The system removes the rule and notifies affected segments of deactivation
tests.observable_evidence: Test capture of the revoked rule and segment notification state

unresolved_decisions: Definition of 'authorized' in terms of role and access level

E-002.statement: The system shall enforce access restrictions between network segments and monitor blocked and allowed traffic, generating alerts for suspicious or unauthorized communication attempts.

tests.given: A network segment with defined access policies
tests.when: An attempt is made to communicate from academic to guest network without authorization
tests.then: The system blocks the connection and generates an alert indicating unauthorized traffic
tests.observable_evidence: Test capture of blocked traffic event and generated alert

tests.given: A legitimate administrative request for inter-building communication
tests.when: Traffic is routed between research and administrative segments via approved policy
tests.then: The system allows the connection and logs it as permitted traffic
tests.observable_evidence: Test capture of allowed traffic event and flow state

tests.given: An anomalous data transfer pattern exceeding threshold behavior
tests.when: A communication attempt is detected with high volume or unusual timing
tests.then: The system triggers an alert indicating suspicious activity
tests.observable_evidence: Test capture of alert generation and event metadata

E-003.statement: The platform shall maintain audit logs of firewall policy changes and administrative actions, provide a dashboard for reviewing network security events, and support multiple campus buildings.

tests.given: An administrator modifies a firewall rule in the research segment
tests.when: The change is applied to the system
tests.then: A log entry is created recording the action, timestamp, user, and affected policy
tests.observable_evidence: Test capture of audit log entry after policy change

tests.given: An operator accesses the security dashboard at a campus building level
tests.when: The operator requests a view of recent events from the last 24 hours
tests.then: The system returns a list of network events with timestamps and severity levels
tests.observable_evidence: Test capture of dashboard response showing security event list

tests.given: A new building is added to the campus network configuration
tests.when: The platform is updated to include the building in its segmentation model
tests.then: The system reflects the new segment in all dashboards and policy views
tests.observable_evidence: Test capture of dashboard showing the new building segment

unresolved_decisions: Definition of 'security events' scope and severity levels
Method for synchronizing building-level configurations across segments
